source: provider_pricing_daily (D1), low_price_last per event x provider x UTC day; query in query.sql (complete 7-reading windows), run 2026-11-22
scope: all tracked shows (mostly US), readings 2026-09-15 to 2026-11-18, at least 14 days before the show, price under $1,000, one site compared with itself for the same show, the other six readings within 3 days either side, all seven days present

contrastMonWedMinusFriSat.note: grouping chosen after seeing the weekday table, so the standard error is optimistic

earlierPeriodNote: July to 14 September (33 to 49 artists per weekday) showed no consistent weekday pattern in the 2026-11-21 run with the looser window; not re-run with complete windows.
revisionNote: First run allowed windows with as few as 5 readings (gap 0.78 pp, 281,915 readings). Review showed gaps can leave a residual trend, so windows were restricted to all 7 readings. Result moved from 0.78 to 0.68 pp.
